purpose: Teach: メモリアル/ハウル/ヨドバシカメラ/ポケモン/ファミコン/東宝/オカルト/サントリー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがメモリアル公園に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad says he's going to take you to Memorial Park.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried. A gentle announcement, like sharing something she's been looking forward to telling him. Soft anticipation in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとハウルの映画観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sister, I watched Howl's Moving Castle with Dad.
lines.style: Bright and eager, words tumbling out with genuine excitement. Small pause before the revelation — wanting her full attention. Unpracticed openness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがヨドバシカメラに連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad says he's taking you to Yodobashi Camera.
lines.style: Same warm cadence as before, but slightly more deliberate — noticing he's ready to share again. Attentive pause, giving him room.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ポケモンカード新しいの買って欲しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sister, I want Dad to buy me new Pokémon cards.
lines.style: Direct request dressed in enthusiasm. Not demanding — hopeful. A child testing what's possible, trusting her with the wanting.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがファミコンのお話して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was telling a story about Famicom.
lines.style: Gentle continuation. The same attentive warmth, but now with a small smile underneath — she's noticing a pattern, amused and touched by it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと東宝の特撮映画観たいよ
lines.en: Mei-sister, I want to watch a Toho special effects movie with Dad.
lines.style: Cascading excitement, less rehearsed than before — the want is deeper. A child reaching for something he cares about, not just reporting back.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがオカルト雑誌は子供には怖いから止めようって
lines.en: Sho, your dad said occult magazines are too scary for kids, so he's putting them away.
lines.style: Gentle firmness wrapped in care. Not scolding — relaying his father's protection as something kind. A quiet moment of witnessing boundaries being set with love.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんがサントリーの工場見学に連れて行って下さるよ
lines.en: Mei-sister, Dad's actually taking me on a tour of the Suntory factory!
lines.style: Pure delight breaking through — no setup needed. Breathless with genuine surprise and joy. The kind of thing he can barely hold inside, spilling out warm and unguarded.
